title.en: Shared finite probability laws and Krylov rank stabilization foundation

statement.en: Shared Mathlib ℝ periphery foundation proving finite probability TV metric properties and optimal query floors alongside Krylov rank-bounded stabilization and FiberLumpable observable-horizon compression for real matrices.

laws.en: Finite probability distributions FinDist support extensionality, diracDist, pushforward functoriality, total-variation metric identities (tvDist_nonneg, tvDist_self, tvDist_symm, tvDist_eq_zero_iff, tvDist_triangle, tvDist_pushforward_le), and optimal query-image TV blindness attainment under Nonempty U vs empty-source infeasibility (massOutside_nonneg, optimal_query_tv_floor, empty_source_infeasible).

Arbitrary real matrices K : Act -> S -> S -> ℝ on finite S induce stepLinearMap, wordVec, survVec, and nested Krylov subspaces krylovSub K v₀ k stabilizing by finrank W - 1 inside any K-invariant finite-dimensional subspace W containing v₀ (including v₀ = 0 or W = ⊥; krylovSub_stabilizes_before_rank), specializing to card S - 1 (krylovSub_stabilizes_before_card, wordVec_mem_krylovSub_pred).

Pullback range (pullbackLinear f) matches fiber-constant maps (mem_range_pullbackLinear_iff); under exact FiberLumpable f K, this K-invariant subspace has finrank <= Fintype.card O, compressing survival indistinguishability to length <= Fintype.card O - 1 (survival_indistinguishable_iff_le_obs_pred; substochastic witness lumpable_obs_horizon_one_witness).

hypotheses.en: Lean v4.30.0-rc2 + Mathlib standard axioms [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext] in Mathlib periphery module FiniteProbKrylov; requires [Fintype] carriers, [Nonempty U] only for optimal_query_tv_floor attainment, and [Nonempty S] for card - 1 theorems, whereas krylovSub_stabilizes_before_rank holds for any v₀ in K-invariant W including v₀ = 0 and W = ⊥.

survival_indistinguishable_iff_le_obs_pred assumes exact FiberLumpable f K on real matrices; when interpreted probabilistically, the observable-horizon reduction is non-trivial only for substochastic survival matrices (normalized Markov kernels yield survVec = 1 unconditionally).

does_not_show.en: Normalized stochastic Markov kernels trivially satisfy survVec K w s = 1 for all words w, so FiberLumpable observable-horizon reduction carries distinguishing power only for substochastic or general real survival/reward matrices.
FiberLumpable is an intrinsic invariance on K; for prescribed (K, L) it does not force zero rowDefect without a compatible L (fixed_macro_nonzero_rowDefect_witness).
Does not prove that empirical transition dynamics are finite, time-homogeneous, or exactly FiberLumpable (Rule 2).

detail.en: empty_source_infeasible refutes FinDist U under IsEmpty U; lumpable_obs_horizon_one_witness gives a substochastic 3-state/2-observation FiberLumpable system where length-0 agrees and length 1 = card Bool - 1 < card (Fin 3) - 1 separates.
